The name Silvano carries the meaning “Man from Silvia” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Latin. historical_references.reference: Saint Silvanus was an early Christian martyr whose feast day is celebrated on July 2nd. He is also known as Silvanus of Tarsus. It is believed that he was a disciple of the Apostle Paul and was martyred in Greece during the reign of Nero in AD 64.

Another Saint Silvanus, also known as Silvanus of Montenegro, was born in the 14th century and was a Serbian Orthodox monk and hermit. He is said to have lived in solitude in the Montenegrin mountains for over 50 years. Saint Silvanus is revered as a protector of the Montenegrin people and is the patron saint of Montenegro.
